title: What Artist Quarter Cities Is
definition: Artist Quarter Cities: cities where working artists anchor the economy.
description:
Strip Artist Quarter Cities to its essence and you get cities where working artists anchor the economy. Simple to say, civilizational to build.

The path runs through Future Cities & Habitats: first gallery districts understanding, then night transit prototypes, then affordable lofts operations at scale. Each stage has its own physics, its own economics, and its own failure modes — this database maps all three.

Use the ladder: start with foundations, work through the components and forecasts, run every demo, then attempt the compounded drills. By the final record you will hold a working mental model of studio hulls, grounded in real research and honest about what remains unknown.

t: Real Research Today: Artist Quarter Cities
title: Real Research Today: Artist Quarter Cities
definition: Today's documented research behind Artist Quarter Cities.
description:
The road to Artist Quarter Cities is already being paved. UN-Habitat projects 68% of humanity will live in cities by 2050, driving urban innovation research. Masdar City in Abu Dhabi was designed as a zero-carbon, car-free urban laboratory.

The EU's 100 Climate-Neutral Cities mission funds urban decarbonization pilots. Together these programs form the gallery districts foundation that Artist Quarter Cities will build on — the night transit results, the affordable lofts methods, and the institutional memory.

Forecasts are projections, not promises: the dated milestones in this database reflect published roadmaps and expert surveys, and they will move as night transit research advances. Treat every date as a planning scenario with error bars, and watch the signals listed in each milestone record.

t: 2030 — The first studio hulls district opens at 50
title: 2030 — The first studio hulls district opens at 50
definition: 2030 milestone on the Artist Quarter Cities roadmap.
description:
The first studio hulls district opens at 50,000 residents, its gallery districts grid and night transit mobility running at full design load.

What must be true first: the gallery districts results have to replicate outside the lab, night transit manufacturing must reach pilot scale, and affordable lofts operations need a year of continuous runtime. Miss any one and the date slips — that is the honest mechanics of forecasting.

Signals to watch: peer-reviewed gallery districts demonstrations, night transit cost curves bending down, and operators — not vendors — reporting affordable lofts uptime. When all three flash green, 2030 stops being a forecast and starts being a schedule. (4 years from the 2026 baseline.)

title: Readiness Estimator: Artist Quarter Cities
definition: Estimates Artist Quarter Cities readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Artist Quarter Cities components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a studio hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

title: Artist Quarter Cities Systems Simulator
definition: Simulates Artist Quarter Cities operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Artist Quarter Cities installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 78248 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where gallery districts monitoring, night transit redundancy, or affordable lofts maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Artist Quarter Cities Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Artist Quarter Cities: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Artist Quarter Cities — cities where working artists anchor the economy.

Phase 1 — Prove (gallery districts): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (night transit): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (affordable lofts): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (mural blocks): studio hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and cultural core-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
